scope: Independent requested-byte/count backing admission for pending-call and reply-token node layouts. The complete existing node owns this reservation alongside its later-bound logical record charge through preparation, publication, claims, detached cleanup and actual deallocation. Connection/capability and endpoint payload layouts and nested buffers remain separate.
artifact_note: Runtime Rust sources were frozen before native campaigns. Subsequent current-documentation edits can change tracked-diff hashes; per-file source and archived artifact hashes identify exercised code. Both architectures test/minimal service bundles were rebuilt and signed for the current SDK; the separate AArch64 Sitas fixture was rebuilt and signed, and every runner regenerated signed security fixtures.

policy.planning: 6144 ordinary pending/reply pairs request 2310144 layout bytes; 8192 total pairs request 3080192. Added inline charges contribute 196608/262144 bytes respectively. These figures exclude nested storage, allocator bookkeeping and independent pool usage. No extra holder allocation is introduced.
policy.decision: Use an independent pool with 6/8 MiB and 18432/24576 node defaults, allowing layout/candidate headroom and a quarter reserve for trusted admission. Existing logical and backing limits remain unchanged. No RAM is preallocated; simultaneous independent ceilings or sustained essential-service fairness are not guaranteed. Measured workloads may justify adjusting central byte/count limits together.
policy.capture: PreparedCall retains the exact caller root before logical count admission. reserve_records captures trusted class from the accepted generation under IPC; both unlocked node factories receive that same original boolean. Promotion, root retirement or ASID reuse cannot reclassify a retained node.
policy.custody: Typed node Charge owns NodeCharge<IpcNodes> plus Option<record_budget::Charge>. The common BindCharge contract binds logical admission without replacing backing. Preparation admits actual layout before allocation; publication and retirement reuse this same node. Payload and actual node deallocation precede both refunds. Complete call and scalar reply/list abandonment retain every field under IPC/heap/pool guards.
policy.errors: Quota/allocator rejection returns IpcError::ResourceLimit. Reply-node rejection cancels the complete pending prefix, original counts and exact root before authority/attachment publication. No physical completion or replay permission is added.

wire.compatibility: Prior catalog identities and record widths remain unchanged. SDK rejects versions 8/9, malformed catalogs and inexact lengths. observe/HTTP/fixtures use the same catalog. Syscall registers and signed runtime ABI are unchanged.
